Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: every wrong submission costs 1 and every demo request costs 1. An
instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import numpy as np
G=np.full((27,27),4,dtype=int)
G[:,13]=1; G[13,:]=1
# source complex pattern
G[3,6]=9
G[4,5]=5; G[4,6]=9
G[5,4]=3; G[5,5:7]=2; G[5,7:9]=1
G[6,4]=3; G[6,5:7]=2; G[6,7:9]=1
# target anchors
G[5:7,20:22]=2
G[19:23,4:8]=2
G[20:22,19:21]=2
orig=G.copy()
# copy source pattern anchored at (5,5), scale to target size, with flips
src=orig[3:7,4:9] # bounding? use all non-background source cells directly
src_cells=[(r,c,int(orig[r,c])) for r in range(27) for c in range(27) if r<13 and c<13 and orig[r,c] not in (4,)]
# exclude all? includes separators c13 no; only source UL cells
# dests (toprow,col,size,flip_vertical,flip_horizontal)
for rt,ct,size,fv,fh in [(5,20,2,False,True),(19,4,4,True,False),(20,19,2,True,True)]:
    s=size//2
    for r,c,v in src_cells:
        # rel from source anchor top-left
        dr,dc=r-5,c-5
        if fv: dr=1-dr
        if fh: dc=1-dc
        rr=rt+dr*s; cc=ct+dc*s
        # Each input cell is scaled to an sxs tile. Restrict to same quadrant bounds, do not cross separators
        for a in range(s):
            for b in range(s):
                r2,c2=rr+a,cc+b
                if 0<=r2<27 and 0<=c2<27 and not (r2==13 or c2==13):
                    G[r2,c2]=v
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in G))
print('non4 counts', {int(x):int((G==x).sum()) for x in np.unique(G)})
